messages.text: I’ll review the fixed study revision and independently check the completed native samples. I’ll compare regional hit coverage and resolution tradeoffs before drawing conclusions from the confirmation runs.

The confirmation data show clear coverage gains, but no candidate meets all the objectives together. Balanced worsens 1 GeV momentum resolution in both response models. Mild and late also have response-dependent or regional regressions, so improvements in their overall averages need to be presented as tradeoffs.
The independent numerical checks are complete. I’m checking the final figure revisions and the wording around forward coverage and momentum tails before returning the assessment.

The figures and tables preserve the coverage deficits and the large high-momentum tails. None of the tested layouts meets all objectives; the mild layout remains a qualified starting point under geometric digitization, with a momentum regression in the Gaussian cross-check.

OPT-PhysVal-03 is complete. **No unresolved numerical or reporting blocker remains within the assigned scope. No tested layout meets the combined objectives**, and this assessment grants no design acceptance.

Reviewed revisions:

- Source fixes: `bfa3c264df56497fff13b3b574a332108ae8d189`; final reduction source `9873280239728ebaceb1f72387b70484a2382f5e`.
- Four final numerical matrices and native inventories: `4c0910045a40869ec4af9b3b0fcf2eb6a8a757ec`.
- Final figures: `171cd0f8a7a3287d28262226f33fc0598336f43e`.
- Final README and complete tables: `0a582d88cd7bc3ec9d383774cd97a02d5053681c`.
- ACTS material semantics: `355ea68493b326956756c9386d2fd9eaf9328568`.

All reviewed working evidence matched its assigned Git bytes. I changed no files and ran no native simulations, builds or installations.

**Actual independent checks**

Using separate uproot/NumPy calculations, rather than calling the implementation’s reducer, I checked:

- **54 unique cases: 348,000 generated events and 347,964 fitted tracks**, including all 30 final confirmation cases: **300,000 generated /299,968 fitted**.
- **378 native output hashes**, executed-source identities, final candidate payloads and common runtime fingerprints.
- Generated/selected/audit/track joins, unique primary identity, zero-barcode guards, physical sensor-ID counts, fit-stage accounting and all-generated coverage in η, φ and joint η–φ.
- Every fitted 6D covariance; reconstructed residuals, wrapped φ, truth-minus-fit pulls, and derived pT/curvature uncertainties including the θ–q/p covariance term.
- **8,714,319 measured-coordinate marginals**, matching frozen float32 variances and independently summed audit dimensions.
- **254,940 scalar checks**, maximum absolute discrepancy **5.69×10⁻¹⁴**; **714 full histograms** and **3,591 retained profile rows** across the reviewed artifacts.
- **1,512 paired bootstrap intervals** across 378 comparison rows; maximum reproduced interval difference **zero**.
- **16 CSV files, 31,638 rows and 240,702 numeric fields**, exact against the numerical artifacts.
- All **28 final PNGs**, including the eight revised full views. The clipped time-density peak is resolved and retained tails remain visible.
- Final Markdown: **18 global comparison rows, 30 case rows and all 17 adverse regional rows**; **537 numeric fields** reproduce the data exactly. The adverse regional list is exhaustive for its stated four diagnostics.

No fitted covariance was invalid; no native Fake fits or native outliers occurred in these reviewed samples. The final missing fits are explicitly retained selection losses. All 15 final Gaussian reports state the effective native boundary policy correctly: **10 retries /11 maximum attempts**, without establishing how many retries actually occurred.

The earlier selected-event duplication, endpoint, undefined-ratio, pull-sign, stage-count and calibration-audit findings are resolved. Six targeted analysis controls and the independent selected-event mutation check passed.

**Scientific findings**

| Objective | Assessment |
|---|---|
| ≥10 physical measurements throughout acceptance | **Unmet.** Mild global coverage is 96.53/96.65/96.83%; balanced 98.20/98.28/98.18%; late 94.77/94.28/94.18%. Their worst signed quarter-η bins remain approximately 81–85%, 89–90% and 72–74%, respectively. |
| Improved impact parameters | Mild geometric global d0 core widths improve 2.4–5.1%, and z0 3.7–6.5%; the 100 GeV d0 interval includes unity. These gains are not uniform: mild Gaussian 1 GeV forward d0 worsens by 7.39%, with pointwise interval [2.79%,13.19%]. |
| Momentum preservation | **Not demonstrated.** Mild geometric 1/10 GeV pT intervals include unity; that is not noninferiority. Mild Gaussian 1 GeV pT ratio is **1.03978 [1.00487,1.06581]**. Balanced geometric 1 GeV is **1.05607 [1.02460,1.08932]**. Late Gaussian 10 GeV curvature is **1.03440 [1.00487,1.06848]**. |
| Forward performance | Meaningful regressions remain. Balanced geometric 1 GeV at \|η\|3–3.5 has pT/curvature ratios **1.1252/1.1441**; at 3.5–4 its d0 ratio is **1.1100**. Further Gaussian and late-control exceptions are accurately retained in the complete tables. |
| Full-distribution momentum behavior | Core improvements do not imply tail improvement. At 100 GeV, geometric fractional-pT full SD is **11.769 baseline versus 26.521 mild**, and **9.493 versus 76.977 late** on its separate seed. Late Gaussian is **7.277 versus 17.593**. These are highly sample-sensitive tail diagnostics, not Gaussian resolutions. |

The final README and tables correctly preserve these conclusions, wrong-charge counts and selection losses. The mild layout can be described as a **qualified follow-up candidate under the geometric primary response**, not an established optimum or response-robust solution.

**Material, response and uncertainty qualifications**

I independently checked **593 carrier audits, 76,950 preserved profile bins and 476 logical calibration layers** across nine representative inputs. Integrated X0/L0/mass-proxy closure agrees within **1.81×10⁻⁷** relative. The added material uses ACTS’s actual slab combination, appears downstream on both ends, and frozen calibration follows physical layer identity, including explicit donor inheritance.

This remains effective-profile relocation. It does not establish component-resolved mass conservation, a new Geant4 map, changed-incidence calibration validity, or service feasibility. Mechanical overlap claims belong to the separately retained native/SysArch evidence; I did not rerun those checks.

Intervals are finite-sample, pointwise bootstrap results with no multiplicity correction, registered noninferiority margin or material/response systematic uncertainty. The Gaussian measurement checks do not establish Gaussian track pulls; time remains prior dominated. Larger independent samples and component-resolved material/engineering work remain necessary before production integration.
